difficulty_descriptions.easy: A small, low-pressure action you can do with little preparation.
difficulty_descriptions.medium: Takes a little thought, planning, or follow-through.
difficulty_descriptions.hard: May feel more personal or require intentional preparation.

activities.title: Send a note of appreciation
activities.description: Message someone a specific thing you appreciate about them. Keep it genuine and make no request in return.

activities.title: Check in with someone
activities.description: Ask someone how they are doing, then give them room to answer without trying to fix everything.

activities.title: Offer one practical help
activities.description: Think of someone who might appreciate help with an ordinary task and offer a specific, manageable option.

activities.title: Make time to listen
activities.description: Reach out to someone and ask if they would like to talk. Focus on understanding rather than steering the conversation.

activities.title: Follow through on an offer
activities.description: If you have offered support recently, check back and do the specific thing you said you would do.

activities.title: Reconnect thoughtfully
activities.description: Contact someone you have not spoken with in a while. Acknowledge the time apart and let them choose whether to continue the conversation.

activities.title: Share a personal thought
activities.description: Tell someone one brief thing that has encouraged you lately, and ask if they would be open to hearing it.

activities.title: Share a short experience
activities.description: Share a personal experience that you are comfortable discussing. Keep it about your own perspective and invite their thoughts.

activities.title: Pass along a helpful resource
activities.description: Send a resource you genuinely found useful, with a sentence about why you thought of them. Ask first if you are unsure they would welcome it.

activities.title: Talk about what matters to you
activities.description: If it comes up naturally, explain one way faith is meaningful in your life. Listen with the same care you hope to receive.

activities.title: Continue a conversation
activities.description: Follow up on a question someone has raised. Share what you know, be honest about what you do not, and offer to look into it together.

activities.title: Start a meaningful conversation
activities.description: Ask someone if they would be comfortable talking about faith or spiritual questions. Let their answer set the direction and pace.

activities.title: Invite someone to something casual
activities.description: Invite someone to join you for a walk, meal, or another ordinary activity. Make it easy for them to say no.

activities.title: Invite someone to a community activity
activities.description: Mention an upcoming social or service activity and share the practical details so they can decide if it sounds enjoyable.

activities.title: Invite someone to serve with you
activities.description: Offer to do a service project together. Explain what to expect and check that the activity works for them.

activities.title: Invite someone to worship with you
activities.description: Invite someone to attend a worship service or faith-centered gathering. Offer to sit with them and answer practical questions.

activities.title: Follow up on an earlier invitation
activities.description: Check whether someone has questions about an invitation you already extended. Be warm, avoid repeated pressure, and respect their decision.

activities.title: Invite someone to meet with missionaries
activities.description: Ask whether someone would like to meet with missionaries to discuss their questions. Explain what the meeting involves and leave the choice with them.

activities.title: Pray for opportunities to share the Gospel
activities.description: Pray for opportunities to share the Gospel and for help recognizing them when they come.

activities.title: Offer to pray for someone
activities.description: If someone shares a concern, ask whether they would appreciate you praying for them.

activities.title: Offer to pray with someone
activities.description: Ask if the person would be comfortable praying together. Respect their preference if they decline.

activities.title: Pray for the missionary work
activities.description: Include local missionaries, people they are teaching, and members sharing the Gospel in your prayers.

activities.title: Give someone a pass-along card
activities.description: Offer a pass-along card when it feels relevant, briefly explaining why you thought they might find it useful.

activities.title: Text a scripture or hymn to a friend
activities.description: Share a scripture or hymn that has meant something to you, with a short note about why it came to mind.

activities.title: Tell someone about your weekend
activities.description: Mention a meaningful part of your weekend, such as attending sacrament meeting, teaching Sunday School, or a Young Men campout.

activities.title: Share your testimony of missionary work
activities.description: On Fast Sunday, consider sharing a sincere testimony about missionary work, if you feel comfortable doing so.

activities.title: Sit with someone new at church
activities.description: At church, look for someone you do not know well, including a friend of the missionaries, and ask if you may sit nearby.

activities.title: Practice inviting with your kids
activities.description: Show your children how to warmly invite a friend to church, seminary, or an activity, and how to respond graciously either way.

activities.title: Write your testimony in a Book of Mormon
activities.description: Write a brief personal testimony in a copy of the Book of Mormon for missionaries to offer to someone.

activities.title: Visit a part-member family with missionaries
activities.description: Coordinate with the missionaries and family first, then join a visit in a way that is comfortable and supportive for everyone.

activities.title: Send a favorite general conference talk
activities.description: Send a friend a general conference talk you enjoy, with a brief note about what stood out to you.

activities.title: Share a recent spiritual journal entry
activities.description: Share a short excerpt or thought from a recent spiritual journal entry, choosing only what you are comfortable making personal.

activities.title: Let the missionaries know about a service opportunity
activities.description: If you know someone who could use help with a task such as yard work, ask permission before connecting them with the missionaries.

activities.title: Invite a friend to meet with missionaries
activities.description: Ask if a friend would like to meet with the missionaries. Explain what to expect and make it comfortable for them to decline.

activities.title: Host a mission story night
activities.description: Invite members and friends to share favorite stories from their missionary experiences. Keep the gathering relaxed and welcoming to everyone.

activities.title: Invite a friend to family home evening
activities.description: Invite a friend to join your family for a home evening activity, and let them know what the evening will be like.

activities.title: Invite a friend to a ward activity
activities.description: Tell a friend about an upcoming ward activity, share the details, and offer to meet them there.

activities.title: Invite a friend to Book of Mormon study
activities.description: Invite a friend to read or discuss a passage from the Book of Mormon together, at a time and pace that works for them.

activities.title: Invite a friend to sacrament meeting
activities.description: Invite a friend to attend sacrament meeting and offer to sit with them.

activities.title: Invite a friend to dinner with the missionaries
activities.description: Ask a friend if they would enjoy having dinner with you and the missionaries, and explain who will be there.

activities.title: Share how the Gospel has changed your life
activities.description: Tell a friend how an aspect of the Gospel of Jesus Christ, such as faith, repentance, or baptism, has influenced your life. Share only what feels comfortable and invite their perspective.

activities.title: Share a copy of the Book of Mormon
activities.description: Offer a friend a copy of the Book of Mormon and let them know you would be glad to talk about it if they are interested.

activities.title: Introduce yourself to a neighbor
activities.description: Knock at a neighbor's door at a considerate time, introduce yourself, and invite them to church. Keep the visit brief and respect their response.
